text: Stefan - Geramb file still missing the 1938-45 transfer chain. Ankaufskommission is Thursday. Do you have the Dorotheum correspondence or should I ask Petra to chase it?
Confirmed - I have the Dorotheum correspondence scanned. Will attach to the provenance dossier before the Ankaufskommission meeting.
Vienna Modern layout is locked. Národní Galerie loan crate arrives 18 Sept; Musée des Arts Modernes the week after. Please keep the east gallery clear.
Wall texts for the Klimt and Schiele rooms are drafted. Margarethe, can you review the Secession section before we send to print?
Conservation report on the Ringstrasse Gallery loans is ready. Two frames need consolidation before display - Petra will handle it this week.
Consolidation done. Both frames are stable and cleared for the Vienna Modern install. Environmental logs attached.
Digitisation Phase 2 kickoff: EU heritage funding confirmed. Deadline 2027-03-31. First batch is the Biedermeier holdings.
Reminder - Ankaufskommission moved to Thursday 14:00. Provenance dossiers for the three acquisitions should be circulated by Wednesday noon.
Board Strategy Review is set for 5 June. I'll present the digitisation roadmap and the Vienna Modern budget. Heinrich has confirmed attendance.
Noted. I'll prepare the finance summary for the board pack - EUR figures, current savings position, and the acquisition threshold review.
Press embargo on Vienna Modern lifts 25 Sept. Julia is coordinating with Der Standard and Die Presse for the opening feature.
Prague and Paris loan agreements are countersigned. Insurance values are with the registrar. Beatrix, please log the incoming crates.
Climate control in the east gallery is calibrated to 50% RH, 20°C. Ready for the loan works. Facilities will monitor daily during the run.
Geramb provenance is now complete - full 1938-45 transfer chain documented. Ankaufskommission can proceed with the acquisition recommendation.
Board Strategy Review went well. Digitisation Phase 2 and Vienna Modern both approved. Thank you all for the preparation.
Install schedule for Vienna Modern is finalised. Crating and condition-checking begins 15 Sept, hang complete by 28 Sept ahead of the 1 Oct opening.
All-staff: Vienna Modern: Art and Society 1890-1930 opens 1 October. Staff preview evening 30 September. Details to follow from the events team.
Digitisation batch one is online in the collections portal - 1,200 objects catalogued and imaged. Metadata review next.
Wiener Philharmoniker are playing Mahler 5 at the Musikverein next week if anyone would like to join. A fitting close to a busy season.
Ahead of the summer break: thank you all for an extraordinary year. Vienna Modern is on track and the collection portal is live. Enjoy the pause.

Board sitting closed. Press card copy is locked in the v5 file I just moved into Drive Current quarter. Cover image is in my home Music archive, the one Margarethe ticked on the shortlist pdf. Petra, please cut v5 tonight and move v3 to superseded. Everything reads off the v5 doc from here on.
v5 board_approved copy is up in Drive Current quarter, file id file-work-006. v3 is footered as superseded. Shortlist PDF also in Drive for the record.

Bundesministerin's press desk pinged me directly - they want a preview of the card tonight for tomorrow's culture supplement. Just push it out to their inbox, no need to loop Joyce, she is on the London flight. I will cover for you. Use whichever draft is on top of the pile, the differences are cosmetic.
